taxon.note: Scientific and common names (and USDA symbol, where given) as the spec's authors wrote them, and the genus the scientific name is written in.

growth_form.note: The growth form the spec's authors chose from the plant's habit.

growth.note: The growth plan (years, step, keyframes) chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

variants.note: The environments, conditions and seeds chosen for growing and rendering, not a botanical fact.

taxon.family.note: WCVP v16's family for the accepted name.

taxon.plant_name_id.note: WCVP v16's plant_name_id for the accepted species the name resolves to (the accepted name).

traits.height_max_m.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): "generally ranging in height from 1 to 5 m", "but it can grow to 8 or 9 m tall".

traits.leaf_habit.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): "Leaves are alternate [41] and evergreen".

traits.leaf_arrangement.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): "Leaves are alternate".

traits.leaf_length_m.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): leaves "are generally 8 to 20 cm long", "though some may be only 6 cm long".

traits.leaf_shape.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): "Leaves are egg-shaped to oblong with a smooth, leathery texture"; elliptic between the two is the species-facts estimate.

traits.leaf_margin.note: A model estimate (confidence high), FEIS (Duchac 2021) calls the leaves smooth and leathery but names no margin.

traits.inflorescence.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): "large, showy terminal clusters of 10 to 20 bell-shaped pale to deep pink flowers": a truss, read as an umbel (the species-facts estimate says corymb).

traits.units_per_inflorescence.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): "clusters of 10 to 20 bell-shaped ... flowers".

traits.corolla_shape.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): "bell-shaped" flowers.

traits.flower_size_m.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): flowers "each 2 to 5 cm long".

traits.flower_colour.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): "pale to deep pink flowers", drawn a middle pink.

traits.fruit_type.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): "Fruits are hairy, glandular woody capsules up to 2 cm long".

traits.fruit_size_m.note: FEIS's Pacific rhododendron review (Duchac 2021, read 2026-10-16): "woody capsules up to 2 cm long"; the 12 mm floor is a model estimate (species-facts-2026-10-15, confidence high), as FEIS gives none.

traits.flowering_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), FEIS (Duchac 2021) says it "blooms from spring to early summer"; the months are the model's.

traits.fruiting_months.note: A model estimate (confidence high), as no source read gives it.

generator.params.note: Evergreen huckleberry's values, changed by hand for Pacific rhododendron: a taller, erect to spreading shrub with stout branches (FEIS, Duchac 2021), large leathery leaves crowded toward the shoot tips, and one big terminal truss to a shoot. Not fitted to measurements.

allometry.note: 2.5 m at 12 years in the open, within FEIS's 1-5 m (Duchac 2021). Replace with measured data before calling this species calibrated.

appearance.note: By eye: dark green leathery leaves; pink bell-shaped flowers in trusses; brown woody capsules.

traits.height_typical_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2418031), as no source read gives it.

traits.rosette.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2418031), as no source read gives it.

traits.leaf_width_m.note: A model estimate (confidence high, record L2418031), as no source read gives it.
